results.question: 各门店销售额排名
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 华东区近30天销售额最高的门店是哪个
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region = '华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 各区域销售额占比
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)*100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders),0), 2) AS sales_share_pct FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)*100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders),0))::numeric, 2) AS sales_share_pct FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 分析华东区最近销售情况
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东' AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as total_sales, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)/COUNT(o.order_id),2) as avg_order_value, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/COUNT(*),2) as refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东'

results.question: 对比华东和华北两个区域的销售表现
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) as refund_rate FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region

results.question: 分析各区域销售额的同比变化
sqls: SELECT s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS year, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) ORDER BY s.region, year
SELECT MIN(create_time) AS min_date, MAX(create_time) AS max_date FROM orders

WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT s.region,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time) AS year,
         COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) AS sales
  FROM store s
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id
  GROUP BY s.region, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.create_time)
)
SELECT y26.region,
       COALESCE(y25.sales,0) AS sales_2025,
       y26.sales AS sales_2026,
       ROUND((y26.sales - COALESCE(y25.sales,0)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(y25.sales,0),0), 2) AS yoy_change_pct
FROM yearly y26
LEFT JOIN yearly y25 ON y26.region = y25.region AND y25.year = 2025
WHERE y26.year = 2026
ORDER BY yoy_change_pct DESC

results.question: 上月销售冠军门店的成功因素分析
sqls:
SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales
FROM store s
LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id
  AND o.create_time >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month')
  AND o.create_time < date_trunc('month', NOW())
GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT store_id, COUNT(order_id) as order_cnt, SUM(amount) as total_sales, AVG(amount) as avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as customer_cnt FROM orders WHERE create_time >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND create_time < date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC

SELECT m.level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.member_id) as customer_cnt, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_cnt, SUM(o.amount) as sales FROM orders o JOIN member m ON o.member_id=m.member_id WHERE o.store_id=28 AND o.create_time >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND o.create_time < date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY m.level ORDER BY sales DESC

sqls: SELECT MIN(amount) AS min_amount, MAX(amount) AS max_amount, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_count FROM orders

SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount),0),2) AS total_refund_amount FROM orders GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY total_refund_amount DESC
